prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Chicago. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Chicago for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need one quick detail first so I give names that are close and a good fit: what Chicago neighborhood or ZIP code are you in (or where do you want to go), and do you have a preference or requirement for Invisalign vs braces, insurance, or a budget?

While you reply, here’s how I’ll pick the best specific orthodontists for you and what I’ll look for (so you know why I’ll recommend them):

What I’ll use to choose specific doctors
- Proximity to your home/work (so visits are convenient).
- Board certification and AAO membership (shows specialized orthodontic training).
- Invisalign provider level or experience with clear aligners (Platinum/Diamond levels indicate many cases).
- Years of experience and reputation for the treatment you want (complex tooth movements vs straightforward clear-aligner cases).
- Patient reviews and before/after case photos.
- Technology (digital scans, 3D imaging, accelerated orthodontics if needed).
- Office logistics: weekend/evening hours, financing and insurance handling, and typical consultation cost.
- Communication style and patient experience (reviews mentioning clear explanations, friendliness, child vs adult friendliness).

Questions to confirm or ask at each office
- Are you an orthodontist or a general dentist? (You want an orthodontist for complex cases.)
- How many Invisalign/clear-aligner cases do you treat per year?
- Do you have experience treating cases like mine (bite issues, crowding, prior braces)?
- What’s the estimated treatment time and total cost (including retainers)?
- What tech do you use (iTero/3D scans, CBCT, AcceleDent, etc.)?
- Are consultations free? Do you offer payment plans/insurance billing?
- What happens if attachments break or I need refinements?

If you give your ZIP or neighborhood and any preferences (Invisalign vs braces, insurance, adult/teen/child), I’ll produce a short, prioritized list of 4–6 specific Chicago orthodontists to call — with one-line reasons for each (experience level, Invisalign status, location, patient ratings, what type of cases they’re best for).
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
